messages_body:
Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion with you and Ben about FinBank's roadmap and the specific security controls you're validating before a procurement decision. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Redwood SOC 2: we maintain SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted platform; I attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We can share the full report under an NDA/procurement flow.
- Encryption: all customer data is encrypted in-transit (TLS 1.3) and at-rest (AES-256).
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys (CMK) for Dedicated and Private deployments via BYOK integrations with major cloud KMS or external HSMs. For Hosted, we offer envelope encryption and can enable a CMK via a cloud KMS integration for enterprise customers — happy to clarify exact options for FinBank.
- Audit & logging: key usage and access logs available via the Redwood Console and cloud KMS audit exports.

Requested next steps: 
1) If you can, please share your vendor security questionnaire (VSA) and any must-have controls — I attached a blank copy of our standard questionnaire and included the SOC2 summary.
2) I'll loop in our security lead (Marissa) to answer deeper technical questions and schedule a 30-min call for the security team. Proposed times: Tue/Thu next week.

Attachments: FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (placeholder), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Let me know the best time to bring Marissa into a meeting and any immediate questions.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

On the call: Alice Johnson (FinBank), Ben Thompson (FinBank), Camila Reyes (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifying questions from our InfoSec side before we schedule the broader security call: 

1) Does Redwood support a customer-managed HSM (FIPS 140-2/140-3) for key material, or do you rely solely on cloud KMS? We need assurance we can retain exclusive key control for certain workloads.
2) For the hosted product: if we enable CMK via cloud KMS, who controls the key policy? Can FinBank restrict key admin and rotation?
3) Key rotation & access logging: does Redwood surface KMS access logs in the Console or do we need to pull logs directly from the cloud provider? Any retention guarantees?
4) Compliance: is Redwood able to sign a BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads?

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Please complete as much as you can and we'll follow up on open items.

Best,
Alice Johnson
Director, Information Security | FinBank
alice.johnson@finbank.com

On Tue, Jun 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking time today — great discussion...

Hi Alice,

Thanks — this is helpful. Answering your questions inline below and summarizing next steps.

1) Customer-managed HSM: For Dedicated and Private deployments we fully support BYOK with customer-owned HSMs (FIPS 140-2/140-3 compliant) — you can bring an external HSM (PKCS#11) or use cloud provider HSM-backed KMS where you control the CMK and key policy. For Hosted enterprise customers we support CMK via cloud KMS (e.g., AWS KMS, GCP KMS) with HSM-backed keys; the practical difference is that in Hosted the key material may remain in the cloud provider's HSM while Redwood controls access via envelope encryption policies. If FinBank requires exclusive on-prem HSM control, Private deployment is the recommended path.

2) Key policy & admin: When you provision a CMK in your cloud KMS and integrate it with Redwood, FinBank retains the key admin controls (IAM/KMS policies). Redwood requests only cryptographic use permissions (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) scoped to service principals. We can provide example IAM/KMS policy snippets.

3) Rotation & logging: Key rotation can be managed either by you (recommended) or automated through KMS. All KMS access events are logged to the cloud provider's audit logs; Redwood surfaces a subset of key-usage metrics in the Console (tokenized usage counts, last-used timestamps). For full audit trails, we recommend forwarding cloud KMS audit logs to your SIEM — retention is determined by your logging pipeline; Redwood can assist with log-forwarding configuration.

4) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads. We sign BAAs for Dedicated and Private customers; for Hosted enterprise customers we can discuss scope during procurement.

Attachments: I completed the vendor questionnaire where we had clear answers and left comments for policy items that require FinBank input. See attached: FinBank_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (filled). Also attached the SOC2 summary again for your security team.

Next steps: 
- Marissa (cc'd) will join the security deep-dive to go through any technical gaps. Can we schedule a 30-min call on Thu Jun 24 at 10:00 AM PT or Fri Jun 25 at 11:00 AM PT?
- If you need more details on HSM integrations, Marissa can share an architecture note and example IAM/KMS snippets prior to the call.

If helpful, I can also open a HubSpot ticket with the questionnaire attached so we have a central place to track open items (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4721).

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
